narrative.overview: Everything on the site orbits the blackhole — the literal signature asset and the organizing metaphor. Content sits in calm, near-black space; mass is violet (structure — borders, surfaces, buttons); light is cyan, and light bends toward what matters. Visual hierarchy is gravity: the closer an element is to conversion, the more light it gathers. The system rejects the generic AI-SaaS template feel and empty spectacle — the cosmos frames content, it never substitutes for it.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black indigo void as the universal canvas; starfield + blackhole video as fixed scenery
Violet glass surfaces (8% alpha fills, 55% alpha borders) with inset glow, never drop shadows
Gradient-crowned headings (purple to cyan) over solid, highly legible body text
Cyan reserved for interaction and proof (links, stats chips, hover accents)
Motion is slow drift and brightening — nothing bounces, nothing spins

rules.name: The Bent Light Rule
rules.body: Violet is structure; cyan is action. A cyan element must be interactive or evidentiary. A violet element never needs to be clicked to be understood.

rules.name: The Legibility Floor Rule
rules.body: On #030014, body copy is gray-300; gray-400 is the absolute floor for secondary text; gray-500 and below is decoration only.

rules.name: The Gradient Crown Rule
rules.body: The purple-to-cyan bg-clip-text gradient is the committed brand idiom for h1/h2 headings — and for nothing else.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Elements never cast darkness; they emit or contain light. Hover intensifies the inset glow — it never adds a drop shadow or scales layout.

dos: Do keep body copy at gray-300 on #030014; gray-400 only for secondary lines.
Do reserve cyan for interactive or evidentiary elements.
Do show receipts in copy: counts, licenses, named features.
Do keep sections one-idea-per-fold with at least 80px vertical padding.
Do give every reveal a prefers-reduced-motion fallback and every video a pause path.
donts: Don't produce the generic AI-SaaS template feel — if a section could be pasted into any AI startup's page, rewrite it around a specific claim.
Don't add new gradient-text elements beyond h1/h2.
Don't use drop shadows, side-stripe borders, or nested cards.
Don't let the cosmos wash out content — no text over the accretion disc without a solid content layer beneath.
Don't ship a second h1, a skipped heading level, or a 'free' label on anything that is a trial.
